name: 1. Empty Username Submission
method: Submitted form with empty input string
result: Rejected with validation message: "Please enter a GitHub username."

name: 2. Malformed Username Submission
method: Submitted invalid characters ("bad_user_name!!")
result: Rejected with format message: "Username can only contain letters, numbers, and hyphens (1–39 characters, no leading/trailing hyphens)."

name: 3. Search Using Enter Key
method: Typed "octocat" and triggered Enter keypress
result: Form submitted; profile loaded successfully: "The Octocat"

name: 4. Search Using Search Button
method: Typed "gaearon" and clicked Search button
result: Form submitted; profile loaded successfully: "dan"

name: 5. Valid Profile & Repo Data Integrity
method: Verified profile fields and repo cards rendered for live GitHub user
result: Rendered Name: "dan", User: "@gaearon", Avatar: valid, Link: "https://github.com/gaearon", Stats: 3, Repos: 12

name: 6. Nonexistent Username 404 State
method: Queried unmapped user account ("nonexist-user-xyz-987")
result: Title: "User Not Found", Msg: "GitHub user not found. Please check the username and try again.", Retry button available: true

name: 7. Simulated Network Failure
method: Intercepted request and simulated connection failure (net::ERR_FAILED)
result: Title: "Connection Error", Message: "Unable to connect to GitHub. Please check your internet connection and try again.", Retry: true

name: 8. Rate Limit Simulation (HTTP 403 + Remaining: 0)
method: Mocked HTTP 403 with X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 and reset timestamp
result: Title: "Rate Limit Exceeded", Msg: "GitHub API rate limit exceeded. Rate limit will reset in about 20 minutes."

name: 9. Distinguish 403 Forbidden from Rate Limit
method: Mocked HTTP 403 with non-zero quota (org restriction)
result: Title: "Access Forbidden", Msg: "Access forbidden (403): Resource blocked by organizational policy"

name: 10. Partial Failure (Profile OK, Repos Fail)
method: Profile returned 200 while /repos endpoint returned 500
result: Profile retained: "Partial Success User", Repo section displayed error: "Could not load repositories", Repo Retry button: "Try Again"

name: 11. Race Condition / AbortController
method: Dispatched slow request (1.0s delay), immediately superseded by fast request
result: Delayed request finished (true), final rendered profile: "Fast User (New Search)" (never overwritten by stale data)

name: 12. Zero Repositories Empty State
method: Loaded user with 0 public repositories
result: Empty state displayed: "No repositories" — "This user doesn't have any public repositories yet."

name: 13. Avatar Fallback & Missing Optional Fields
method: Loaded profile with broken avatar URL, null bio, location, company, blog, name
result: Avatar fallback rendered with initial "M", name defaulted to username "mock-missing-fields", meta items count: 0 (clean layout without empty items)

name: 14. Repository Pagination / Load More
method: Queried user with 14 repos across 2 pages; triggered Load More
result: Initial cards: 12, After click: 14, Load More button removed at list end: true

name: 15. 3D Spatial Tilt Pointer Responsiveness
method: Dispatched mouse movements over .prism container and evaluated transform
result: Initial: "none", On hover: "rotateX(4.59161deg) rotateY(4.54867deg)", Reset: "rotateX(0.0416564deg) rotateY(0.0412669deg)"

name: 16. Spatial 3D Multi-Layer Depth Configuration
method: Inspected CSS perspective, preserve-3d, and translateZ layers
result: Container perspective: 1200px, Scene transform-style: preserve-3d, Layer count: 4

name: 17. Background Video Attributes & Playback
method: Evaluated HTML5 <video> attributes and current playback state
result: Src: "http://localhost:5173/videos/hero-bg.webm", Muted: true, PlaysInline: true, Loop: true, Duration: 9.2s, Poster: "http://localhost:5173/images/hero-poster.jpg"
